$comment: The collector's Apify rules (issue #926, parent #817): which actors a run may call, what each call may return, which enrichments are forced off, and how many actor calls one run may make. apify-guard.mjs enforces every value here as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook, so the caps are code rather than Claude's obedience. An actor may be called only while its own actorIdConfirmed is true: an id and input field names nobody has verified against the real actor are a guess, and the guard refuses to spend money on a guess, so confirming an actor after the dry run is a deliberate one-line change in this file. This file sets no dollar amount (owner decision, 31 October 2026, #926): spending is capped by the Apify account usage limit (maxMonthlyUsageUsd, with overage disabled), which suspends runs once it is reached, and the Claude Console spend limit; neither is this file's business. Reaching the call cap stops the run - the searches it did not reach are recorded as not_searched by the run completion (#937) - which is deliberately the failure mode rather than a loop. The three retailer schemas were verified on 31 October 2026; identity verification alone does not enable paid calls. maxPages is the search page cap. For an actor that pages internally, pageLimitField names its own page-cap input: the guard keeps a smaller positive request, sets maxPages when none is given and refuses a larger one, while pageSize/maxItems bounds the total products returned.

perRun.$comment: One collector run. 71 tracked products across the four Apify routes is roughly 350-400 calls with pagination, so 600 calls is a ceiling a normal run does not reach and a loop cannot pass.

varnmill/au-supermarket-prices.$comment: Coles, Woolworths and ALDI. Keyword search is noisy ('kinder bueno' returned eggs in the owner's testing) and Claude filters it; products mode with prefixed ids (coles:5216969, woolworths:66527) is precise and is the fallback for a known listing missing from a day's search. onlyChanged is forced off because every listing must get a positive check (#925), and paid details are forced off because they are billed and nothing reads them.

abotapi/kmart-au-scraper.$comment: Kmart. Its keyword search is to be confirmed in the dry run (the issue says so). Reviews and local-stock enrichment are forced off: both are billed and neither is a price. Exact actor identity and input schema verified read-only on 31 October 2026. actorIdConfirmed remains false until the paid dry run verifies output and cost.
